Students attending grad school part time can often more easily maintain a consistent work schedule while pursuing a degree. Part-time students also have more time to dedicate to studies and courses that are relevant to their work. Part-time graduate students might also be able to dedicate more time to job opportunities.
Working while pursuing a degree has the downside of time limitations. Part-time students might discover that completing their degree takes them longer than expected. Certain part-time students might also require a second job to ensure they have enough income. Also, going to grad school part time could result in higher tuition costs, depending on your school system.
